paint.method: All alpha>0 glyph pixels compared exactly (RGBA delta=0) with an independent one-label/native opaque-background reference at the original integer raster plane. Expanded same-plane reference checks clipping. Every glyph pixel background is sampled from an actual full drawing with text removed; no source drawing mutated. Original alpha>=250/delta>24 metrics retained independently.
